card: Read the Windows cleanup list before removing anything.
title: windowsweep before a disk cleanup
intro: windowsweep names the paths it might clear and starts with a dry-run. Personal files need a deliberate choice.

sections.heading: What is windowsweep for?
sections.body: It is a Windows cleanup command you can run without an install through npx.

sections.heading: What happens before deletion?
sections.body: It shows the proposed paths in a real dry-run before deletion.

sections.heading: How are personal folders handled?
sections.body: Personal files are chosen one row at a time, rather than swept in with the rest.

sections.heading: Where does windowsweep fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps a personal record. windowsweep helps you make a deliberate choice about which Windows disk paths to remove.
